<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="director"><label>Director(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="producer"><label>Producer(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="production company"><label>Production company</label></data>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="starring"><label>Starring</label></data>	
        <data source="music"><label>Music by</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="release date"><label>Released</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|future||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|canceled||{{{release date}}}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="runtime"><label>Run time</label></data>	
        <data source="budget"><label>Budget</label></data>	
        <data source="language"><label>Language</label></data>        
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="canon_timeline"><label>Timeline&#32;<small>&#32;([[Canon]])</small></label></data>
        <data source="legends_timeline"><label>Timeline&#32;<small>&#32;([[Star Wars Legends|Legends]])</small></label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Movie|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
